title: Chapter 1462
text:
In the World Tree's main body dimension, the war had already reached its climax.

Black Star and the Tree God had already disappeared for a long time. Due to the sudden change, the galactic alliance army did not know the situation. Countless officers and soldiers could only endure their uneasiness and fear and continue to participate in the war.

Due to the lack of Black Star, the advance of the main force was also slow.

At this moment, the galactic alliance fleet had barely broken through to the second layer of defense, and the World Tree Blessed Race did not care about the cost to reinforce the defense line. The battlefield was like a millstone, crushing the battleships and soldiers into powder. The casualties were uncountable, and both sides suffered heavy losses.

Without Black Star's support, the advance of the Beyond Grade As was also blocked. However, the quality and scale of their combat strength still exceeded the current high-level combatants of the World Tree. The two sides fought for a long time, and the Beyond Grade As of the galactic society had already killed most of the high-level combatants of the other side.

However, because the Beyond Grade As lacked the strength of Black Star, who could ignore the large-scale galactic battlefield, even if they killed many experts of the World Tree, they could not go deep. Instead, due to the fierce artillery fire of the World Tree Blessed Race, they did not dare to charge too far forward and be used as a target. They could only retreat to the vicinity of the main force to cooperate. Although there was not much danger with Aurora's help, the Beyond Grade As were temporarily unable to reverse the current stalemate. After all, the World Tree had too many troops.

"I wonder where Black Star was taken to. Can you contact him?"

Kasuyi pressed his hand on his forehead and controlled his psychic energy to shatter the enemies one ship after another. He asked in the Beyond Grade A combat channel with a worried tone.

"I can't contact him. It's most likely that the Tree God used some trump card to prevent Black Star from continuing to advance and brought him to some alternate space. He probably can only come out after a victor is decided."

Hella replied casually. She swept the cold current of death across the fleet, and red ice crystals grew out of the interior of these battleships, bursting through the hull.

"Black Star won't lose, right?" Oulou asked hesitantly.

"There's nothing to be afraid of. Whether Black Star wins or not, he can come and go as he pleases." Hella was not worried about Han Xiao's safety at all.

"It's hard to say. The World Tree Civilization has developed to this point and is unfathomable. Who knows what other trump cards it has?

Maybe Black Star will fall for it too … "

Hella, Aurora, and the others weren't worried.

However, there were also many Beyond Grade As who were worried.

It wasn't that they didn't believe in Black Star's strength, but a war of this scale?

No one could say for sure what would happen. As the saying goes, concern leads to confusion.

Black Star shouldered the responsibility of leading the association and was also the controller of the Sanctum Revival?

It was hard for some of the Beyond Grade As not to feel nervous, especially since they knew nothing about Black Star's situation.

At the same time?

Yao was in the strategic command center?

Wuornos' remote projection was also present, watching the battle.

Most of the Beyond Grade As in the galactic society were involved in this war, but Wuornos was not one of them.

When Ethereal came looking for him, he still refused to participate in this battle?

The reason was the same as before — he needed to maintain a perfect state at all times?

He did not want to waste his energy in other aspects, lest he missed the opportunity to step into the Transcendent Grade.

Because Black Star, a real Transcendent, was participating in the battle, the Arcane Church did not force Wuornos to take action. However, Wuornos requested to watch the battle, which was not rejected.

The officers and staff officers were discussing the battle endlessly?

Wuornos did not interrupt from the beginning to the end and stood alone on the sidelines?

He silently watched the battlefield.

He was not very interested in the battle. Requesting to watch the battle?

The main reason was that he wanted to see the battle of a Transcendent Grade and use this to inspire himself?

However, this idea fell through.

"Black Star and the Tree God should be fighting in an alternate space?

Unfortunately, I can't see it … "

Wuornos sighed.

He only watched a small portion of the battle between the two of them on the main battlefield?

They did not even use any of their trump cards. He could not help but feel that it was a pity that he could not see the rest of the battle. He only felt that he had not had enough and his heart itched.

If he could watch the entire battle between the two Transcendent Grade Supers, his chances of stepping into the Transcendent Grade might be higher …

Just as he was feeling regretful, a strange feeling suddenly surfaced in his heart. He could not explain it clearly. It was an inexplicable intuition, as if he had missed something.

"Strange …"

This feeling came and went quickly. Wuornos pressed his chest, a little confused.

Before he could think carefully, the officer beside him suddenly exclaimed.

Wuornos turned around and saw Black Star, who had disappeared for a long time, appear on the battlefield again, immediately causing the situation to change.

In the fifth layer of the World Tree's defense circle, right where the two of them had disappeared, a shattered green light suddenly bloomed, and a huge figure flew out. It was Han Xiao's Supreme Heavenly Venerate.

"Black Star is back!"

The Galactic Alliance Army was overjoyed. They hurriedly widened their eyes and waited for the Tree God to appear.

However, the next moment, the green light exploded and turned into light fragments, but the Tree God did not come out. It was as if he had really disappeared.

"Where's the Tree God? Where did he go? "

Many people were energized, and they had a guess that made them slightly excited.

Before they could ask, Han Xiao connected to the combat channel again and confirmed their guess.

"I've already eliminated the Tree God. He won't obstruct our actions anymore. Continue attacking!"

Han Xiao let out a sigh of relief.

Seeing that the battlefield was still in a stalemate, he was relieved. He was afraid that he would be entangled by the Tree God for too long, causing the battlefield to change. Nothing unexpected had happened.

He did not delay and continued to charge toward the World Tree's main body without hesitation. Enduring the enemy's focused fire, he forced his way into the defense circle alone.

Seeing that Han Xiao did not mention anything about the battle, although they were curious, they did not ask further. To them, it was enough to know the outcome.

"Follow Black Star!"

"Victory belongs to us!"

The Galactic Alliance Army's morale was greatly boosted. They swept away their uneasiness and followed closely behind, launching even more ferocious attacks.

However, to Han Xiao's surprise, he thought that after the Tree God died in battle, the morale of the World Tree Blessed Race would be low and they would be defeated. However, the result was the opposite.

Not only did the World Tree army not retreat, but their counterattack became even more intense. They abandoned all their worries and fought with their backs to the wall.

The casualties were extremely tragic, but the World Tree Blessed Race did not retreat. The fleets on the periphery abandoned their frontlines one after another and teleported to the fifth layer of defense. They launched a suicidal charge at Han Xiao like moths to a flame, using their lives to build a barrier and slowing down his advance at all costs.

In fact, all the members of the World Tree had seen the entire process of the Tree God resisting Black Star through the mental network.

Every time the Tree God erupted, everyone knew the price the Ancestral Tree King had paid. Seeing the Tree King, who was like a totem of faith, risk his life at all costs, countless members of the World Tree could empathize with him. They nervously cheered him on, hoping that the Tree God would defeat Black Star with his explosive power.

However, their high hopes turned into disbelief time and time again. Seeing that the Ancestral Tree King had paid such a huge price, only to be completely killed by Han Xiao, a huge sense of tragedy crashed into the hearts of all the members of the World Tree, leaving them with only despair.

All the members of the World Tree understood that there were no experts who could stop Black Star, but this instead stimulated their final determination.

As the saying went, a desperate army would definitely win. Not only did the morale of the World Tree Blessed Race not decline, it even increased exponentially. No one gave up. Everyone was willing to die and drag the enemy down with them.

If they could not rely on the Tree God, they would rely on themselves!

All the fear and confusion faded away, leaving only the determination to die. This was the final counterattack of a civilization at the end of its road!

Boom! Boom!

The densely packed battleships blocked the path ahead. Han Xiao attacked time and time again, and sabers and cannons flashed non-stop. Every time, they could shatter a large number of battleships. However, there were people filling in the gaps at all times, so it was difficult to clear a path.

Continuous high-density explosions surrounded him. Han Xiao felt as if he had fallen into a swamp, and it was difficult for him to move. The pressure from the front was even greater than the pressure from the Tree God.

"What a tenacious civilization …"

Han Xiao was slightly moved. Although they were opponents, he had to admit that the tenacity and resilience displayed by the World Tree Civilization exceeded his previous judgment.

In his previous life, even the galactic society that was united against the outside world was slightly weaker than the World Tree. In the final battle, the World Tree fleet in his previous life did not show such determination.

"Although the World Tree is a deformed civilization, I'm afraid they won't be able to find any match in the entire universe in terms of unity and cohesion …"

Han Xiao shook his head.

He admired the World Tree's desperate fight, but unfortunately, without the Tree God, the World Tree could no longer stop him. All of this was futile.

Han Xiao looked back at the large army that was quickly following behind him. His gaze swept across the Beyond Grade As at the front.

The Beyond Grade As of the association all understood the hint in his gaze. They quietly spread out and formed a loose formation in front of the various armies.

If one did not look carefully, they would not be able to see that they were like a net that wrapped around the fleet at the front.

The victory was already decided. What he had to consider now was how to pick the peaches … Oh no, it should be preventing others from picking the peaches.

Seeing this, Han Xiao turned around. His eyes flashed, and he activated a Character Summon Card.

'Golden Ring' Oulou's Character Summon Card — (Golden Treasure Ship-Ram)!

Dense streams of light suddenly appeared on the body of the Supreme Heavenly Venerate. He adjusted his direction and suddenly took a step forward, aiming at the World Tree's main body and charging forward in his Super Armor state!

The World Tree fleet that was blocking in front could not withstand it at all. They shattered on the surface of the Supreme Heavenly Venerate's shield, and the wreckage flew everywhere!

The Supreme Heavenly Venerate was like a huge golden meteor, directly piercing through the last defense circle and crashing into the World Tree's main body.

Bang!

Countless roots seemed to have been struck by lightning. They suddenly curled up, and even the entire dimension shook!

"Let me see what you are!"

Han Xiao hooked his finger and stabbed it into the tree trunk, injecting energy into it.

At this moment, the World Tree's main body, which had been sitting there waiting for death, finally revealed its secret card!

Buzz!

In an instant, the consciousness of all the members of the World Tree turned into a terrifying mental attack with unprecedented lethality. It followed the energy link between the two sides and charged toward Han Xiao's brain.

This mental attack was so strong that even if all the Beyond Grade As in the galactic society worked together to resist, their minds would be shattered in the blink of an eye!

The World Tree's main body was not without the ability to move. When the two sides built a physical or energy connection, she could launch a mental attack on the target. This was because only by invading her with energy could one form a soul connection with her and take the initiative, turning her into a Universal Treasure that could be controlled. This move was her trump card to protect herself from being enslaved by outsiders!

However, at this moment, Han Xiao, who was already on guard, opened another Character Summon Card without hesitation.

'Underworld' Onicelu Character Summon Card — [Ten Thousand Soul Stream]!

Immune to all mental attacks!

In his brain, a destructive mental current bombarded Han Xiao's mental body, but it was like a breeze that did not cause any damage. Instead, it turned into pure energy and was absorbed by Han Xiao.

"I've been prepared for this … Come and meet your natural enemy!"

Han Xiao's eyes lit up. The next moment, a translucent snake shot out from between his brows, and its body expanded at an unbelievable speed.

The Pivotal Snake had already become a virtual life form. Its body could expand and contract at will in the material world. In the blink of an eye, its body became the size of the World Tree. It coiled around the World Tree's main body, opened its mouth, and bit down without hesitation.

With this bite, the Pivotal Snake finally established an information bridge with the World Tree's main body. Countless information began to be exchanged rapidly.

Buzz! Buzz!

The entire World Tree's main body trembled violently like a person struggling in pain. Even space trembled violently!

In order to subdue the World Tree, Han Xiao naturally came prepared. Establishing a soul connection was only one aspect. The biggest problem was actually to destroy the World Tree's resistance, and his trump card was the Pivotal Snake.

After the Pivotal Snake transformed into a virtual life form and rapidly grew up, it automatically awakened a new ability. Only then did it truly show why it was the World Tree's natural enemy … The World Tree's independent consciousness was its food!

It was only then that Han Xiao understood the meaning of the Pivotal Snake's existence. It could turn the World Tree from a special life form into an unconscious Universal Treasure!

It was precisely because of this trump card that Han Xiao finally made up his mind to carry out the plan to subdue the World Tree. He would not do anything that he was not confident in.
